thread:
harper: Cascade.ai reached out / billing ops / they were charged an unexpected $6,720 surge on INV-22111 after a pricing experiment toggled an aggressive retry policy. Customer says they never ran those jobs. Can someone audit?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-22111 (2027-03-08) attached. Charge: Overage surge $6,720.
mikey: I pulled the experiment logs. The "retry-backoff-v3" flag briefly enabled for a cohort that included a few customer keys due to a targeting rule misfire (2027-03-07 23:42 UTC). Affected requests count ~850.
ravi: If surge = $6,720, proposed customer outcome = full reversal of surge + $200 goodwill. Total credit = $6,920. GLs: AR-Adj-6300, Promo-7700. Need finance lead OK (> $5k).
karen: I can approve up to $10k for operational incidents. Please include memo "experiment-targeting-misfire" and tag cost center COGS-Platform.
ops-bot: [automated] Feature flag rolled back at 2027-03-07T23:50Z. Incident ID INC-2027-44 created.
billing-bot: [automated] Adjustment ADJ-9123 created; credits queued: $6,920. Updated invoice INV-22111-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-9123 / AR-6300 / PROMO-7700.
harper: Drafting external note to Cascade.ai: "Hi Cascade.ai — we identified a pricing experiment targeting misfire that resulted in unintended retries and an overage. We've reversed the surge ($6,720) and added a $200 goodwill credit; your updated invoice (INV-22111-v2) is published and the credit will appear on your next statement. We've rolled back the flag and added a guard to prevent user keys being included. Apologies for the disruption. — Harper, Billing Ops"
mikey: Add a line with a contact for escalation (mikey@redwood.com) and offer to run a usage report if they want more detail.
harper: Sent. Cascade.ai replied: "Thanks for the quick fix and the explanation. Please send the usage report."
ravi: I'll attach the usage export and close ticket #70321. Also adding internal note to block the experiment until QA verifies the targeting rules.
harper: Closing thread.
